purpose: Creative card illustration prompts, not new divination meanings

cards.name: The Fool
cards.keyword: การเริ่มต้น
cards.scene: The reference rabbit begins a gentle adventure, facing right, with one foot lifted just before a small rounded cliff edge while remaining safely on solid ground. Carry a peach cloth travel bundle on a wooden stick over one shoulder. A tiny friendly white dog follows. Add one ivory flower, lavender hills, a winding path and a small warm yellow sun. The expression is open and curious. Communicate a fresh beginning and an unknown journey. Keep the figure fully visible.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.keyword: การดึงดูดและลงมือทำ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands confidently behind a small rounded table. Display exactly one cup, one short silver sword, one golden pentacle coin and one wooden wand; the rabbit holds that single wand above the table, so do not add another wand on the tabletop. Its free paw gestures toward the ground. A simple ivory infinity loop floats above its ears. Add a few peach flowers and green leaves. Communicate turning an idea into action through attention and resourcefulness.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.keyword: ความรู้สึกที่ซ่อนอยู่
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits quietly between two simple rounded columns, one pale lavender and one deep plum. A folded blank scroll rests on its lap. Place a small crescent moon near its feet and a soft lavender curtain behind it, lightly patterned with seed-like dots. Its tiny eyes look calm and thoughtful. Use spacious, symmetrical composition and very little decoration. Communicate intuition, private feelings and quiet observation. Keep both ears visible; no large headpiece.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.keyword: ความรัก การดูแล และเสน่ห์
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits comfortably on a peach cushion in a flourishing garden, gently cradling a small blooming plant. Add a modest crown of ivory flowers between its ears, rounded green leaves, golden wheat and a winding lavender stream. The scarf remains visible. Use soft abundant shapes without crowding the silhouette. Communicate warmth, creativity, affection and nurturing care. Keep the rabbit's body and clothing consistent with the reference, with no pregnancy depiction.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.keyword: ความมั่นคงและการควบคุม
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits upright on a broad, simple lavender stone throne. A small warm yellow crown rests between its ears. Hold one short rounded ceremonial scepter, with the other paw resting calmly on the armrest. Rounded plum mountains form a stable background; place four simple square stones beneath the throne. Communicate dependable structure, responsibility and clear boundaries through a composed expression and balanced symmetry. No armor, imposing human anatomy or aggressive expression.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.keyword: ความสัมพันธ์ที่เป็นทางการ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit acts as a gentle teacher, seated on a slightly raised cushion beneath a simple arch. Two smaller rabbits sit in front, listening attentively. Place a blank open book and two crossed warm yellow keys on the floor, with a small lamp beside them. Keep the teacher's scarf visible and its ears uncovered. Communicate shared values, guidance, commitment and learning together. Use an inviting community room rather than an elaborate religious building.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.keyword: ความรักและการเลือก
cards.scene: Two rabbits stand at equal height, facing each other and gently touching front paws. The left rabbit is the exact reference mascot with its orange-and-green scarf. The companion has the same simple drawing style, a pale lavender scarf and slightly different ears. A small peach heart floats above their joined paws. Two curved paths meet into one path toward a distant hill, framed by two leafy plants. Communicate mutual affection and choosing one another. No third character.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.keyword: การเดินหน้าความรัก
cards.scene: The reference rabbit rides in a small rounded lavender chariot, looking forward with quiet determination. Two cute pony-like companions, one ivory and one dark lavender, stand side by side in front. Their poses align toward the same destination. A broad curved road leads between soft hills beneath a tiny star canopy. Keep the rabbit's scarf and full ears visible. Communicate purposeful progress and bringing different impulses into balance, without a race, battle or dramatic speed blur.

cards.name: Strength
cards.keyword: ความอดทนและความอ่อนโยน
cards.scene: The reference rabbit gently rests one paw on the mane of a small friendly peach-colored lion. The lion sits peacefully with relaxed eyes; neither character is restrained. Place a simple ivory infinity loop above them and a few small flowers around their feet. Use rounded shapes and a calm open composition. Communicate courage through patience, kindness and self-control. Keep the rabbit's tiny dark eyes and coral nose unchanged. No forceful mouth opening, wrestling or aggressive teeth.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.keyword: การอยู่ลำพังและทบทวนใจ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands alone on a rounded lavender hill, wearing its familiar scarf and holding one small lantern with a single warm yellow star inside. Its other paw holds a simple walking staff. A narrow path curves gently into the purple distance. Keep the lantern glow soft and flat rather than cinematic. Communicate thoughtful solitude, reflection and finding a quiet direction. The mood is peaceful and inward-looking, not abandoned or frightened.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.keyword: จุดเปลี่ยนและวัฏจักร
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands beside a large circular wheel decorated with a repeating sequence of simple leaf, flower, fruit and seed icons. A small peach pointer marks one point on the rim. The wheel is complete and unobscured, with no letters, numbers or inscriptions. Tiny clouds and stars frame it, while the rabbit lightly touches its edge. Communicate cycles, changing circumstances and a turning point. Keep the design playful and readable rather than mechanical or ornate.

cards.name: Justice
cards.keyword: ความจริงและความยุติธรรม
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits upright on a simple symmetrical lavender seat. Hold one small balanced scale in one paw and exactly one upright silver-gray sword in the other, well clear of the face and ears. Both scale pans are level and visible. Add a calm peach curtain and a straight central path. Communicate fairness, truth, accountability and careful choices. Use a kind but attentive expression, without a blindfold or threatening pose.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.keyword: การรอและการหยุดนิ่ง
cards.scene: The reference rabbit hangs peacefully upside down from one ankle beneath a low curved branch, supported by a broad soft peach ribbon loosely looped around the ankle. Bend the other leg comfortably. Its ears and scarf follow gravity. Add a flat warm yellow halo behind its head and a few lavender clouds below. Communicate a voluntary pause and a new perspective. Keep the entire figure visible. No distress, injury, tight bindings or anything around the neck.

cards.name: Death
cards.keyword: การจบเพื่อเปลี่ยนผ่าน
cards.scene: The reference rabbit gently sets a dried flower beside a new green sprout, standing at a small open garden gate. Behind it is a bare lavender shrub; ahead, peach flowers open beneath a rising warm yellow sun. One fallen leaf drifts across the scene. Communicate ending one chapter and making room for transformation. Keep the mood tender, clear and hopeful while retaining the sense of a meaningful goodbye. No skeleton, corpse, weapon, injury or frightening imagery.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.keyword: การปรับตัวและเยียวยา
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands beside a small lavender stream with one foot on a rounded bank and the other touching shallow water. Hold exactly two simple cups, pouring one smooth continuous ribbon of water from the higher cup into the lower cup. Both cups remain visible and distinct. Add a few ivory flowers and a soft sunrise. Communicate patience, healing, moderation and finding a comfortable balance. Keep the pose physically clear and the water gentle.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.keyword: แรงปรารถนาและพันธนาการ
cards.scene: Two cute rabbits sit beside an oversized peach candy tied with a loose lavender ribbon. The familiar mascot gently notices the ribbon loop around its paw; the loop is clearly open and can be slipped off. A playful soft shadow behind the candy suggests two tiny horns, without becoming a scary creature. Communicate temptation, attachment and noticing a habit that holds you back. Maintain an affectionate tone. No cages, pain, nudity or forced restraint.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.keyword: ความจริงที่ทำให้สั่นคลอน
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands safely on the ground beside a small lavender toy-like tower. A single stylized warm yellow lightning zigzag loosens its roof; a few soft square blocks fall into a cushion of clouds, away from the rabbit. The rabbit looks surprised but unharmed. Add a clearing peach patch in the purple sky. Communicate a sudden disruption that reveals what needs rebuilding. Keep all characters on the ground, with no fire, injury or people falling.

cards.name: The Star
cards.keyword: ความหวังและการเยียวยา
cards.scene: The reference rabbit kneels beside a quiet lavender pool, pouring water from two small pitchers, one into the pool and one onto a tiny green plant. Above it, place one large warm ivory star with seven smaller stars, all simple rounded shapes. Keep the scarf visible and the face peaceful. Use open sky and generous negative space. Communicate renewed hope, gentle recovery and trust returning after a difficult period.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.keyword: ความไม่แน่ใจและความกลัว
cards.scene: The reference rabbit pauses at the start of a winding path between two rounded lavender towers. A large pale peach moon shines above a quiet pool, with a small friendly crab near the water. Add one tiny light-colored dog and one darker dog beside the path, both calm. Use soft overlapping shadows and a curious, slightly unsure expression. Communicate uncertainty, imagination and taking time before deciding. Keep the scene mysterious but reassuring, never frightening.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.keyword: ความสุขและความชัดเจน
cards.scene: The reference rabbit joyfully rides a small friendly ivory pony through a simple sunflower garden. A large warm yellow sun with a gentle face sits above them against a lavender-purple sky. The orange-and-green scarf streams lightly to the side. Use rounded sunflower petals, spacious composition and the brightest ivory and peach accents in the deck. Communicate happiness, openness, clarity and a carefree moment. Keep both rabbit and pony fully visible and simply drawn.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.keyword: การตื่นรู้และโอกาสครั้งที่สอง
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands on a small hill and rings one tiny warm yellow bell. Three smaller rabbits nearby lift their heads as they wake from a peaceful rest among lavender clouds. A soft ivory circle opens in the sky like morning light. Use attentive, hopeful expressions rather than surprise or fear. Communicate a moment of recognition, listening to an inner call and choosing a fresh start. No graves, corpses, punishment or frightening religious imagery.

cards.name: The World
cards.keyword: ความสมบูรณ์และการปิดวงจร
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands happily in the center of a complete oval wreath of muted green leaves and peach flowers. Its arms open gently, with the scarf visible and both feet inside the frame. Place four small corner motifs: a star, a cloud, a leaf and a flower. Behind the rabbit, a curved path returns to its starting point. Communicate completion, belonging and the satisfying close of a journey. Keep the entire wreath and rabbit visible.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.keyword: ประกายรัก
cards.scene: The reference rabbit holds exactly ONE upright wooden wand with two fresh muted green leaves and one tiny peach bud at its tip. The wand is the central focus, clearly separate from the ears. A warm ivory spark floats just above the bud. Add a simple rounded hill and open purple sky. Communicate a new spark of enthusiasm and the wish to begin. Include no other staffs, sticks, branch-like props or wand motifs in the border.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.keyword: การมองอนาคต
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands on a low rounded balcony, holding a small lavender globe with a simple ivory curved coastline. Include exactly TWO upright wooden wands, one on each side of the rabbit, both fully visible. The rabbit gazes toward two distant curved paths that separate across soft hills. Communicate considering possibilities and planning what comes next. Keep the scene spacious and curious. No extra staffs, tree trunks or stick-like decorative props.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.keyword: การรอคอย
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands on a rounded hill overlooking a quiet lavender sea. Show a three-quarter rear view with its head turned enough to reveal the coral nose and one tiny dark eye. Include exactly THREE wooden wands: two planted beside the rabbit and one held in a paw. Two tiny sailing boats sit near the horizon. The scarf drifts gently sideways. Communicate patient anticipation and waiting for progress. No extra staffs or stick-like decorations.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.keyword: ความสุขและการเฉลิมฉลอง
cards.scene: The reference rabbit and a companion celebrate beneath a simple leafy garland supported by exactly FOUR upright wooden wands: two on the left and two on the right, spaced so all four are easy to count. Place a small cozy house in the distance and a few peach flower petals on the ground. Both rabbits look relaxed and happy. Communicate welcome, shared joy and reaching a milestone. No extra posts, fence stakes or sticks.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.keyword: การแข่งขันและความขัดแย้ง
cards.scene: Five small rabbits, including the reference mascot, take part in a playful practice game on a soft lavender field. Each rabbit holds exactly ONE wooden wand, making exactly FIVE wands in total. Arrange the wands in an open fan with their ends clearly separate and countable. Expressions show lively disagreement and concentration, never anger or fear. Communicate competing ideas and learning to cooperate. No injuries, aggressive blows or additional sticks.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.keyword: การได้รับการยอมรับ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit rides a small ivory pony with a simple green leaf wreath around its neck. The rabbit holds ONE upright wooden wand with a peach ribbon. Plant FIVE additional wands beside the path, arranged as two on the left and three on the right, for exactly SIX wands total. Small flower petals suggest a welcoming celebration. Communicate recognition, encouragement and a shared success. Do not add any other staffs or posts.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.keyword: การปกป้องจุดยืน
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands calmly on a small rounded hill, holding ONE wooden wand diagonally in front of its body. SIX additional wands are planted lower on the hill in two clear groups of three, making exactly SEVEN. The rabbit maintains a steady, determined expression. Use an open purple sky and a few tiny ivory stars. Communicate protecting a personal boundary while staying composed. No attackers, fighting, sharp points or extra staffs.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.keyword: ความรวดเร็ว
cards.scene: Show exactly EIGHT wooden wands moving diagonally through the open purple sky in parallel, with clear gaps between them. Each has one or two small green leaves and a soft peach motion trail. The reference rabbit stands below, looking up with pleased surprise, holding no wand. A curved lavender stream and distant hills form the lower scene. Communicate swift movement, messages arriving and momentum. No extra sticks or duplicate wand-shaped trails.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.keyword: ความระแวดระวัง
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands attentively beside a low garden boundary made from EIGHT upright wooden wands. It holds ONE additional wand at its side, making exactly NINE in total. Keep each wand clearly separated. The scarf is slightly rumpled but the rabbit is safe, upright and calm. Add one small peach flower beyond the boundary. Communicate perseverance, caution and protecting hard-earned progress. No injury, bandages or extra fence posts.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.keyword: ภาระความรัก
cards.scene: The reference rabbit carries exactly TEN slender wooden wands in a broad, clearly countable fan across its body. The bundle is bulky but does not cover its face or ears. It walks slowly along a short path toward a nearby cozy cottage. Show a concentrated, mildly tired expression without distress. Communicate taking on too much and nearing the end of a demanding task. Keep the ten wand tips separate; no extra sticks or posts.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.keyword: ข่าวสารและความอยากรู้อยากลอง
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands on a small lavender hill, studying exactly ONE upright wooden wand with a fresh peach bud. Its ears tilt with curiosity and one paw gently touches a new leaf. Add a small blank rolled note tied to the wand with an orange ribbon, without any writing. Keep the familiar scarf visible. Communicate curiosity, an encouraging message and excitement about trying something new. No additional wands or ornate costume.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.keyword: ความเร่าร้อน
cards.scene: The reference rabbit rides a small peach pony in a playful forward trot, holding exactly ONE wooden wand angled gently upward. The pony's feet and rabbit's ears remain fully in frame. The familiar scarf flows backward with a short curved trail of peach petals behind them. Use lavender hills and a clear purple sky. Communicate bold enthusiasm, attraction and eagerness to act, without aggression, armor or dramatic speed blur.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.keyword: เสน่ห์และความมั่นใจ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits confidently on a simple lavender throne, wearing a small warm yellow crown between its ears. Hold exactly ONE wooden wand in one paw and one sunflower in the other. A tiny friendly dark-plum cat rests beside the throne. The orange-and-green scarf remains visible. Communicate warmth, magnetism and comfort with one's own presence. Keep the expression welcoming and the silhouette simple, with no additional wands or elaborate crown.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.keyword: ความเป็นผู้นำและความมุ่งมั่น
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits upright on a broad peach-and-lavender chair with a small warm yellow crown between its ears. Hold exactly ONE wooden wand with a fresh green sprout. A tiny friendly lizard sits on a rounded stone near its feet. Beyond the chair, a clear path leads toward distant hills. Communicate vision, initiative and encouraging others to move forward. Keep the face kind and purposeful, not stern or intimidating.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.keyword: ความรักที่เริ่มผลิบาน
cards.scene: The reference rabbit gently presents exactly ONE large rounded ivory cup between both paws. A small peach heart floats above its rim, while a soft stream of lavender water overflows into a shallow pool below. Add two green lily leaves and a few tiny ivory stars. Keep the rabbit's face and cup clearly separated. Communicate a fresh opening of the heart and feelings beginning to grow. No other cups, bowls or goblets.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.keyword: ความรู้สึกที่ตรงกัน
cards.scene: The reference rabbit and a companion with a lavender scarf face each other at equal height. Each holds ONE rounded cup, and the two cups meet gently in the center, exactly TWO total. A small peach heart with two soft ivory wings floats above their meeting point. Add a quiet garden path and two small plants. Communicate reciprocal affection, agreement and emotional connection. No extra cups or background vessels.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.keyword: มิตรภาพและการเฉลิมฉลอง
cards.scene: Three cute rabbits, including the reference mascot, stand in a small friendly circle celebrating together. Each raises ONE ivory cup, making exactly THREE cups, with each rim clearly visible. Peach petals and a few rounded berries decorate the ground. Keep all faces, ears and paws readable. Communicate friendship, support and shared happiness. The mood is a gentle garden celebration. No extra cups on tables or in the background.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.keyword: ความเฉยชาและไม่พอใจ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits beneath a broad rounded leafy canopy, looking thoughtful and a little distracted. Place THREE cups in a neat row on the ground in front of it. A small soft cloud presents ONE additional cup from the side, for exactly FOUR. Leave space between every cup. Communicate emotional distance, hesitation and not yet noticing an offered connection. Keep the expression mild, not despairing. No additional vessels.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.keyword: ความเสียใจและความเสียดาย
cards.scene: The reference rabbit looks gently down at THREE tipped-over cups on a lavender path, with small harmless puddles beside them. TWO upright cups remain behind its shoulder, clearly visible, making exactly FIVE. A small curved bridge and peach sunrise appear in the distance. Communicate disappointment while leaving room to notice what still remains. Keep the rabbit safe and the mood tender. No broken glass, damage or extra cups.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.keyword: ความทรงจำและคนจากอดีต
cards.scene: The reference rabbit offers a small cup filled with ivory flowers to a younger-looking companion. Include exactly SIX cups: ONE being offered, FOUR arranged separately along a low garden wall and ONE on the ground beside them. Every cup contains a small flower and remains countable. Add a tiny cozy cottage and peach paving stones. Communicate fond memories, kindness and familiar affection. No extra cups or hidden containers.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.keyword: ความฝันและตัวเลือก
cards.scene: The reference rabbit looks thoughtfully at exactly SEVEN cups resting on seven separate lavender cloud puffs. Each cup holds one different simple possibility: a flower, a small house, a heart, a crown, a moon, a star and a tiny ribbon-wrapped gift. Arrange them in clear rows of three and four. Communicate imagination, many possibilities and the need to choose carefully. Keep the icons simple; do not duplicate cups or add vessels.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.keyword: การเดินจากไป
cards.scene: The reference rabbit walks gently away along a curved lavender path toward a distant hill, turning its face slightly so the coral nose remains visible. Leave exactly EIGHT cups behind in two tidy rows of four, with a clear gap between the rows. A small pale moon guides the path. Communicate choosing to leave something emotionally unfulfilling and seeking a deeper direction. Keep the departure calm, with no danger or extra cups.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.keyword: ความพึงพอใจ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits contentedly on a peach cushion before a curved low shelf displaying exactly NINE ivory cups in one spaced row. Keep every cup fully visible, with no overlap. The rabbit smiles softly, paws resting comfortably on its lap. Add a few small stars and a simple lavender curtain. Communicate gratitude, personal satisfaction and enjoying a wished-for moment. No extra cups in the rabbit's paws or elsewhere.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.keyword: ความสุขและครอบครัว
cards.scene: The reference rabbit, a companion and two smaller rabbits enjoy a peaceful garden together. Above them, a soft peach-and-lavender rainbow supports exactly TEN small ivory cups, spaced evenly across the arc and easy to count. A tiny home, green lawn and winding stream complete the scene. Communicate shared happiness, emotional belonging and family warmth. Keep all rabbits fully visible. No cups in their paws or extra vessels near the house.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.keyword: ข้อความหวานและความรู้สึกใหม่
cards.scene: The reference rabbit holds exactly ONE ivory cup close to its chest and looks at a tiny friendly peach fish peeking from the rim. The fish and cup are clearly separate from its face. Add a quiet lavender shoreline and a few small curved ripples. The familiar scarf stays visible. Communicate a sweet message, an unexpected feeling and emotional curiosity. Keep the fish charming and simply drawn. No other cups or vessels.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.keyword: การเกี้ยวพาราสี
cards.scene: The reference rabbit rides a small ivory pony at a slow, gentle walk, presenting exactly ONE cup forward in one paw. A tiny peach heart floats above the cup. A lavender stream curves beside the path, with two small flowers nearby. Keep the rabbit's scarf, the pony's full body and the cup visible. Communicate a thoughtful invitation, romance and approaching someone with care. No armor, extra cups or rushing action.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.keyword: ความรักที่เข้าใจความรู้สึก
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits beside a quiet lavender pool on a simple rounded chair. It holds exactly ONE softly decorated lidded cup in both paws, looking toward it with a caring expression. Wear a small warm yellow crown between the ears and retain the familiar scarf. Add a few green water leaves and one ivory shell. Communicate emotional understanding, listening and gentle care. No additional cups or ornate realistic jewelry.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.keyword: ความรักที่เป็นผู้ใหญ่
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits calmly on a broad lavender chair on a small stable island. Hold exactly ONE ivory cup in one paw while the other rests openly on the armrest. A small warm yellow crown sits between its ears. Soft waves move around the island without reaching the chair; a tiny boat passes far away. Communicate emotional steadiness, maturity and compassion during changing circumstances. No extra cups or threatening sea.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.keyword: ความจริงและความชัดเจน
cards.scene: The reference rabbit holds exactly ONE upright silver-gray sword with a simple warm yellow hilt, clearly separate from its face and ears. A small green leaf wreath floats around the upper blade, with one ivory star above. Lavender clouds part behind it to reveal an open purple sky. Communicate clarity, a truthful realization and a fresh decision. Use a rounded fantasy sword with no cutting action or other blades.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.keyword: การลังเลและปิดใจ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits quietly on a rounded stone, holding exactly TWO silver-gray swords crossed loosely in front of its chest without touching its body. The face remains fully visible, with tiny eyes gently closed in thought. Place a pale crescent moon above a calm lavender sea. Communicate indecision and pausing between two choices. Keep the pose comfortable and both swords easy to count. No blindfold, distress or additional blades.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.keyword: ความเจ็บปวดทางใจ
cards.scene: Place a large soft peach heart above the reference rabbit, with a small zigzag seam suggesting an emotional crack. Exactly THREE silver-gray swords pass behind the heart, with their hilts and tips separately visible; none touches a character. The rabbit holds a small ivory handkerchief and looks gently sad. Three soft lavender raindrops fall from a cloud. Communicate heartbreak and acknowledging painful feelings. No blood, wounds, realistic damage or additional swords.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.keyword: การพักและเว้นระยะ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit rests peacefully on a peach cushion inside a quiet lavender alcove. Display exactly FOUR silver-gray swords: THREE spaced vertically on the wall and ONE lying horizontally on a low shelf beneath them, all safely away from the rabbit. A small ivory star shines through a rounded window. Communicate rest, recovery and taking a needed pause. Keep the atmosphere cozy and the rabbit clearly sleeping comfortably. No coffin or extra blades.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.keyword: ความขัดแย้งและเอาชนะ
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands thoughtfully beside exactly THREE swords resting together on a low lavender rack. TWO additional swords lie separately on the grass in the foreground, making exactly FIVE. In the distance, two companions walk apart with mild disappointed expressions. Keep all blades away from bodies. Communicate disagreement and questioning whether winning was worth the distance created. No fighting, threats, injuries or additional sword shapes.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.keyword: การเดินออกจากปัญหา
cards.scene: The reference rabbit and a small companion sit safely in a rounded lavender boat crossing calm water toward a softly lit shore. Exactly SIX silver-gray swords stand in a secure rack at the front of the boat, arranged as two clear groups of three and not touching passengers. Use a peach scarf-like sail instead of an extra long pole. Communicate a gentle transition away from trouble toward calmer conditions. No additional blades.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.keyword: การหลบเลี่ยงและความไม่ตรงไปตรงมา
cards.scene: The reference rabbit tiptoes away from a small lavender picnic area, carrying exactly FIVE short silver-gray swords in a wide, clearly separated fan. TWO swords remain standing in a low rack behind it, for exactly SEVEN total. The rabbit glances sideways with an uncertain, secretive expression rather than a villainous grin. Communicate avoiding a direct conversation or acting indirectly. Keep every blade away from bodies, with no attack or extra swords.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.keyword: ความกลัวที่จำกัดตัวเอง
cards.scene: The reference rabbit stands inside a loose semicircle of exactly EIGHT silver-gray swords planted safely in the ground, four on each side. Leave a clear open path in front of it. A soft lavender ribbon lies loosely around its paws with visible open ends, not binding them. The rabbit looks uncertain but can leave. Communicate feeling restricted by fear while possibilities remain. No blindfold, sharp contact, injury or extra blades.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.keyword: ความกังวลและคิดมาก
cards.scene: The reference rabbit sits awake on a small peach bed, paws resting near its cheeks, with a mildly worried expression. Exactly NINE small silver-gray swords appear as separate flat motifs across the lavender wall behind it in three rows of three. None is near its body.
